aggregation.selection: All annotated status=Traced endpoints; positive weights; body self-loops excluded. Partition by superclass and somaSide; missing annotations labeled unclassified/U. Intra-group connections retained separately.
limits: Complete source file scanned, but endpoints filtered to Traced annotations.
Groups are cell classifications and soma side, not neuropil parcels or geographical regions.
Aggregating removes neuron-level paths and dynamics; it does not preserve their shortest paths.
Counts are not bandwidth capacities, latencies or a server deployment plan.
Includes brain and ventral nerve cord; not a full-brain emulation.
aggregation.attribution: MaleCNS collaboration: FlyEM / HHMI Janelia, University of Cambridge, MRC LMB and Google Research.

inputs.key_scope: Four opaque synthetic cache keys; exported SHA-256 composites preserve original owner assignment. No live address, RPC response or DEX trace is queried.

scope.failure_control_scope: Fixed failed-role masks before run; external caller bypass for failed ingress; no repair/discovery cost.

historical_replay.warning: Historical BSC/DEX/churn labels are preserved only as audit provenance; counters are synthetic and do not measure these claims.
